identity.notes: The current Reston-only site and the frozen Toast storefront bind to the same Suite 130 restaurant and phone, 571-313-1563. The frozen commonsfooderie.com domain is defunct. Fairfax and Tysons sibling locations and the former same-building Community Canteen are separate and are not merged.

sources.excerpt: Current Reston-only official homepage identifies The Commons Fooderie Reston at 12011 Sunset Hills Rd STE 130, Reston, VA 20190, with phone 571-313-1563.
Current official Reston menu was inspected in full for sandwiches, wraps, panini, burgers, salads, bakery, coffee, cold drinks, soups, grab-and-go products, breakfast, omelets, breads, and sides.

Current official Reston catering page says the restaurant will make its best attempt to accommodate gluten-free, vegan, and allergy requests and asks customers to call about specific requests; it does not guarantee safety.
Current official Reston catering ordering menu was inspected in full. Fifty-four food and nonalcoholic products were inventoried; utensils and chafing/serving utilities were excluded.

Fresh inspection of the live exact-address Toast storefront inventoried every visible food, nonalcoholic drink, and edible retail product, retaining current out-of-stock catalog entries. Modifiers include optional gluten-free toast and a generic special-request advisory, but no allergen matrix.
The job's frozen domain failed DNS resolution during fresh inspection. Current exact-location identity is instead published on tcfooderiereston.com.
Historical listing identifies Community Canteen at the same 12011 Sunset Hills Road address. It is a former separate concept, not a current Commons Fooderie menu surface.

Fresh official-domain searches for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, gluten, PDFs, and downloads found no current product-by-allergen matrix, nutrition guide, or standalone allergen document.
Fresh exact-name and exact-address web searches found the official menus and linked ordering presence but no authoritative product-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy.

findings.summary: The exact current restaurant is The Commons Fooderie Reston at Suite 130 on tcfooderiereston.com; the frozen commonsfooderie.com domain is defunct.
Community Canteen is a historical same-address concept and is not merged into the current Commons Fooderie inventory.
All four mandatory search classes are complete, but no current official product-by-allergen matrix or standalone cross-contact guide is available.

The current record requires the complete union of the official main menu, live Toast catalog, and separate current catering menu; six frozen products are stale and many live products were missing from the baseline.
